name: Image
description: A resilient image with a two-step fallback chain, intrinsic dimensions, and an LCP priority flag
designIntent: Organizer images are hotlinked and periodically 403, move, or die. Image keeps cards and banners free of broken-image boxes and layout shift by always emitting intrinsic dimensions, trying a known-good fallback source, and finally rendering consumer-provided fallback content. Priority is opt-in for the one above-the-fold image per page.

props.name: src
props.description: Primary image URL; hotlinked sources are expected

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible description of the image content

props.name: fallbackSrc
props.description: Second URL tried before the fallback node, such as generated placeholder art

props.name: fallback
props.description: Content rendered when every URL has failed (icon, initials, empty panel)

props.name: priority
props.description: Load eagerly with high fetch priority for the LCP image

props.name: width
props.description: Intrinsic width used to reserve layout space (CLS)

props.name: height
props.description: Intrinsic height used to reserve layout space (CLS)

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the image element

props.name: imgClassName
props.description: Additional image classes, merged with className

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the image element

examples.title: Event card image
examples.code:
<Image
  src={event.imageUrl}
  fallbackSrc="/images/event-placeholder.svg"
  alt={`${event.title} event image`}
  width={1200}
  height={630}
/>
examples.description: Hotlinked organizer image with a generated fallback

examples.title: Hero image
examples.code:
<Image
  src="/hero.jpg"
  alt="Dancers on the competition floor"
  width={1600}
  height={900}
  priority
/>
examples.description: The single above-the-fold image loads eagerly

examples.title: Initials fallback
examples.code: {initials(org.name)}} />
examples.description: Render an identity tile when no image survives

antiPatterns.title: Don't omit width and height
antiPatterns.explanation: Without intrinsic dimensions the browser cannot reserve space and a failed image shifts the page. The defaults exist so there is no reason to omit them; override them to the real aspect ratio.

antiPatterns.title: Don't set priority on every image
antiPatterns.explanation: Only one image should compete for LCP priority. Marking a grid eager delays everything else.

antiPatterns.title: Don't describe the component in alt text
antiPatterns.explanation: Alt text describes the content. Screen readers already announce that it is an image.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid: <Image alt="Image of a dancer" />
// Prefer: <Image alt="Dancer mid-turn on the floor" />

accessibility.implementation: alt is required by the type system and rendered on every img
accessibility.userRequirements: Describe the content; use an empty alt only for decorative images

accessibility.implementation: Intrinsic width and height are always rendered, including after a fallback swap
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass the real aspect ratio for the surface

accessibility.implementation: A failed chain renders fallback content instead of a broken-image glyph
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a fallback for cards where the image carries meaning
